# Draft for the author: add CBOR boundary, depth, append and ordering tests

The sk-cbor unit and doc tests leave several boundaries uncovered. The proposed patch adds 12 tests for the full unsigned range, the public read/write wrappers’ default constant (127), read_nested/write_nested None pass-through with 128 arrays, the tag branch’s nesting budget, appended output, equal-prefix array/map ordering, same-tag content ordering, and duplicate rejection in `assert_sorted_keys!`. The depth tests compare decoded structure and exact encoded bytes, and assert failure under the default limit.

Existing nesting coverage includes `test_read_too_much_nesting_error` through private Reader methods and `test_write_single_levels`, `test_write_nested_map_levels`, `test_write_unbalanced_nested_containers` and `test_write_overly_nested` through private Writer methods. `test_write_nested_map_levels` and `test_write_overly_nested` also assert that `None` succeeds. The new tests cover the wrapper constants, public `None` pass-through and tag branches left uncovered by those tests.

The tagged-nesting tests pin “a tag counts as one nesting level”, and the `None` tests pin “None = unlimited”. The docs imply these contracts but do not state them. Maintainers are invited to confirm or reject these contracts.

A local mutation check found 19 surviving mutants in sk-cbor's own unit and doc tests (78 unit tests and five doc examples). The focused tests pass on the subject and detect their corresponding surviving mutants. The append behavior also has downstream coverage in `libraries/opensk`; the local unit test makes that contract explicit in the codec suite.

The initial PR contains no Appendix table test or conversion probes for M079–M081, M084–M085 and M091–M092. Four deferred tests remain in the acceptance package: consolidated numeric conversions, array conversion, unsorted map conversion with duplicate rejection, and the complete supplied vector corpus. Signed conversions cover MIN, -1, 0 and MAX.

Both test patches apply independently at the subject and locally fetched develop commits, and their tests and rustfmt checks pass. See [UPSTREAM-REVIEW.md](UPSTREAM-REVIEW.md) for versions and evidence. The separate [documentation patch](upstream-doc.patch) corrects `cbor_map_options!` to describe a construction panic for duplicate keys and fixes the `write_nested` error link to `EncoderError::TooMuchNesting`; no code changes and no normative wire deviation.
